back_text: Meet 50 friendly dinosaurs, from the mighty T-Rex and gentle long necks to tiny hatchlings and silly party dinos. Every picture is big, bold and simple, so little hands can colour with confidence.
Thick outlines and large open spaces make this book ideal for toddlers, preschoolers and early school-age kids who are just learning to hold crayons, markers or pencils.
Single-sided pages mean no bleed-through, so kids can colour as wildly as they like. A perfect gift for any dinosaur-loving child.

description_html:
Big, bold dinosaurs for little hands to colour!

50 cute and friendly dinosaur designs with thick outlines and large spaces: perfect first colouring for toddlers, preschoolers and early school-age kids.

  • 50 single-sided pages (blank backs, no bleed-through)
  • Thick, bold lines and big open spaces, easy to colour inside
  • T-Rex, Triceratops, Stegosaurus, baby dinos, sea reptiles, and silly dinos at a party, on a skateboard or in space
  • Each picture is labelled with a big hollow word to colour too
  • Large 8.5 x 11 inch pages

A great gift for any dinosaur-loving child ages 3-6, ideal for birthdays, car trips and quiet time.
cover_prompt: A bright, cheerful prehistoric scene for kids: a smiling green T-Rex, a friendly orange Triceratops, a purple Stegosaurus with round plates, a gentle blue long-necked Brachiosaurus, and a baby dinosaur hatching from a spotty egg, with a small volcano, big ferns, fluffy clouds and a sunny sky.
